article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 50% Sativa / 50% Indica
Genetics: Frostbanger Auto F4 × Sundae Thumper
Breeder: Fast Buds
THC Content: 26-30%
CBD Content: Less than 1%
Terpene Profile: N/A
Primary Flavors: Sweet cream, fresh fruit, spice, dessert gas
Flowering Time (Indoor): 7–8 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: 70–75 days from seed
Indoor Yield: 425–550 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 3–9 oz. per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Sundae Frost Auto was bred around a simple but demanding idea: make an autoflower finish quickly without giving up the extreme resin, potency, and flower quality normally associated with longer-running premium cannabis. Fast Buds combined its Frostbanger Auto F4 with Mephisto Genetics’ Sundae Thumper, producing an F1 feminized autoflower capable of reaching approximately 30% THC while completing its entire life cycle in only about 70–75 days. The flowers live up to the “Frost” portion of the name, developing a dense coating of trichomes that can make mature buds look almost powdered with ice, while the aroma moves between sweet cream, fresh fruit, spice, and a deeper dessert-gas character.

The strain is also unusually balanced genetically, sitting at roughly 50% sativa and 50% indica. Plants remain compact enough for smaller gardens at approximately 60–100 cm tall, yet they can develop heavy, resinous colas and surprisingly strong yields for such a short cycle. Two visual expressions appeared during breeder testing: one stays predominantly green with occasional pink or purple accents, while another can develop nearly black foliage around green and purple flowers. Despite the difference in color, both retain the same general terpene direction, making Sundae Frost Auto a cultivar where appearance can vary dramatically without losing the core sweet, spicy, and fresh personality.
Genetics and Lineage

Fast Buds created Sundae Frost Auto from Frostbanger Auto F4 × Sundae Thumper. Frostbanger Auto F4 supplies much of the raw potency and resin behind the cross. The parent became especially notable after winning the Strongest Autoflower title at the Autoflower World Cup, giving Fast Buds a proven high-THC foundation for the project. By the fourth filial generation, Frostbanger Auto had already undergone substantial selection, allowing the breeder to use a relatively refined parent rather than an early-generation autoflower with unpredictable structure.

Sundae Thumper contributes a very different but complementary background. Mephisto Genetics developed it from Gelato #45 × Forum Stomper, creating an autoflower designed to capture the creamy, sweet, lemon, grape, and gas qualities of Gelato #45 while retaining the vigorous autoflowering traits of Forum Stomper. Gelato #45 itself comes from Sunset Sherbet × Thin Mint Cookies , linking Sundae Frost Auto indirectly to some of the most influential modern dessert genetics. Forum Stomper adds additional Cookies-family resin and grape-oriented depth while helping stabilize the automatic flowering habit.

Crossing those two award-winning autoflower lines gives Sundae Frost Auto an unusually modern pedigree for a fast-cycle plant. Frostbanger pushes potency and frost, while Sundae Thumper contributes creamy dessert terpenes, dense flower morphology, and a balanced head-to-body effect. The F1 structure also helps explain the strain’s vigorous growth and relatively consistent overall architecture. Although coloration can differ sharply between plants, the breeder observed a stable aromatic direction across both major phenotypes.
Effects and Experience

The experience generally begins more brightly than the heavy trichome coverage might suggest. A moderate serving can produce a quick increase in mood and mental engagement, making music, conversation, gaming, or creative activity feel more immersive. The 50/50 genetic balance prevents the opening from behaving like an extreme sativa, however. Instead of becoming relentlessly energetic, the cerebral phase tends to feel clear, euphoric, and socially comfortable before physical relaxation begins to catch up.

As the session continues, the body side becomes increasingly apparent. Muscles loosen, movement feels less urgent, and the initial mental lift settles into a calmer, heavier plateau. This progression reflects the Sundae Thumper side especially well, since that parent is itself recognized for beginning as a headier hybrid before moving toward a relaxing body high. With Sundae Frost Auto, the transition can be more forceful because the total THC potential reaches approximately 30%.

That potency places the cultivar among the stronger autoflowers available. Experienced consumers may appreciate the depth and duration, but newer cannabis users should approach it cautiously. Too much can produce dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, rapid thoughts, or temporary anxiety before the heavier physical stage develops. Smaller amounts better preserve the contrast between mental uplift and body relaxation, while larger servings are more likely to emphasize the strain’s dense, calming finish.
Medical Benefits

Sundae Frost Auto may appeal to medical cannabis consumers who prefer a hybrid effect rather than a cultivar that commits entirely to stimulation or sedation. During the earlier phase, the brighter mental state can make stress, low mood, or mental fatigue feel less intrusive. That sense of uplift can remain compatible with low-pressure activities at a modest dose, particularly for consumers already comfortable with potent THC-rich marijuana.

Physical relaxation grows more pronounced later, which may make muscular tension or general discomfort less distracting. At stronger doses, appetite can increase and the strain may become considerably more restful, moving naturally toward evening use. The very high THC ceiling means dosage deserves particular attention, however. A cultivar capable of approaching 30% THC can be far more intoxicating than a moderate-potency hybrid even when the aroma and flavor feel smooth and dessert-like.

CBD remains below 1%, so the experience is primarily THC driven rather than cannabinoid balanced. Exact terpene ratios are not standardized across every plant, although the breeder consistently describes sweet, fruity, spicy, and fresh aromatics. Medical consumers should therefore rely on batch-specific testing when available and consider medications, personal THC sensitivity, tolerance, and previous cannabis response rather than assuming the strain name guarantees a particular therapeutic result.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Sweet cream forms the softer side of the profile. The Sundae Thumper influence brings a dessert quality reminiscent of creamy Gelato-style cannabis, while fruit adds brightness above it. Depending on the plant and cure, the fruit can feel like a generalized ripe sweetness rather than one specific berry or citrus note. That restraint keeps the flavor from becoming excessively candy-like.

Spice and freshness provide the contrast. The breeder repeatedly highlights a sweet, spicy, and notably fresh scent across both tested phenotypes, suggesting that color differences do not substantially change the central aromatic identity. Beneath those notes sits a deeper gas component inherited from the parent lines, adding enough fuel and resin to give the flower weight. The combination can be thought of as dessert gas with a fresher, spicier edge rather than a pure creamy Gelato profile.

On the palate, sweetness and fruit tend to arrive first, while spice and gas become more noticeable through the exhale. Vaporization can preserve the lighter creamy and fresh notes particularly well, whereas combustion usually makes the deeper resinous character more obvious. Because this cultivar was bred for substantial trichome production, a careful dry and slow cure are especially important; rushing post-harvest handling can flatten the lighter aromatics while leaving only the heavier gas behind.
Growing Information

Sundae Frost Auto is compact, fast, and designed for efficient turnover. Plants generally finish around 60–100 cm tall, allowing them to fit comfortably in smaller tents, greenhouses, balconies, and discreet outdoor spaces. Because the cultivar is an autoflower, it does not require a change to a 12/12 light schedule to initiate bloom. The internal developmental clock begins moving toward flowering automatically, which means early stress should be minimized because there is less time to recover than with a photoperiod marijuana plant.

Fast Buds lists approximately 7–8 weeks of flowering, while the breeder’s full-cycle evaluation places the total seed-to-harvest period at roughly 70–75 days. Indoor yields can reach approximately 1.4–1.8 oz./ft², equivalent to roughly 425–550 g/m², when lighting, root health, irrigation, and canopy exposure are optimized. Light low-stress training early in development can help spread branches without slowing the plant, but aggressive topping or repeated high-stress techniques are less forgiving on such a short schedule. Dense trichome coverage becomes one of the most obvious late-flower traits.

Outdoors, plants can produce approximately 80–250 grams each and do not depend on shortening day length to finish. Growers can therefore schedule multiple runs during a long warm season rather than waiting for autumn. Good direct sunlight, a loose root medium, consistent watering, and protection from prolonged rain help maximize production. The two principal phenotypes offer additional visual interest: one remains greener with subtle purple or pink accents, while another develops much darker, almost black foliage around green-and-purple buds.
FAQ
What strains make Sundae Frost Auto?
Sundae Frost Auto was bred by Fast Buds from Frostbanger Auto F4 × Sundae Thumper. Sundae Thumper was created by Mephisto Genetics from Gelato #45 × Forum Stomper.
How much THC does Sundae Frost Auto have?
Fast Buds lists THC at up to approximately 30%, with CBD below 1%. Actual potency can vary with phenotype, lighting, plant health, harvest maturity, drying, curing, and laboratory methodology.
Is Sundae Frost Auto indica or sativa?

The breeder classifies it as a balanced 50% sativa and 50% indica hybrid. Its effects commonly reflect that balance, beginning with a brighter cerebral phase before developing stronger physical relaxation.
How long does Sundae Frost Auto take from seed to harvest?
Fast Buds reports approximately 70–75 days from seed to harvest under suitable conditions. The active flowering portion is listed at roughly 7–8 weeks.
How much does Sundae Frost Auto yield?

Indoor production is listed at approximately 1.4–1.8 oz./ft², roughly 425–550 g/m². Outdoor plants can produce around 3–9 ounces each, or approximately 80–250 grams, depending on environment and plant size.
Final Thoughts on Sundae Frost Auto

Sundae Frost Auto demonstrates how far autoflower breeding has moved beyond the small, low-potency plants that once defined the category. Fast Buds paired the award-winning Frostbanger Auto F4 with Mephisto Genetics’ Sundae Thumper to create a 50/50 hybrid capable of approaching 30% THC while completing its entire cycle in roughly 70–75 days. That combination of speed and potency is the foundation of the strain’s appeal.

Its visual and aromatic traits make the genetics more interesting than raw performance numbers alone. Heavy frost covers the buds, one phenotype may remain predominantly green, and another can develop almost black foliage with purple accents. Sweet cream, fresh fruit, spice, and gas remain consistent across those visual differences, giving the cultivar a recognizable sensory identity even when plants look dramatically different.

For growers, compact 60–100 cm plants, indoor yields around 425–550 g/m², outdoor production up to roughly 250 grams per plant, and automatic flowering create an efficient production package. For consumers, the experience moves from euphoric mental engagement toward deeper physical calm, backed by enough THC to demand respect. Sundae Frost Auto stands out as a modern high-performance autoflower: fast, intensely resinous, visually distinctive, and built from two breeding lines with proven competition credentials.
